title: Easily a top pick of the fringe: The Real Kyle McCarren ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
transcript: Easily one of my favorite shows of the fringe so far. The real Kyle Mccarren. This is a gorgeous musical about Andy's high school best friend who went off to college and died tragically young, and Andy looking back on all of the time that they spent together creating music, and what happens as he's dealing with the grief in the days of following this tragic death. This was both an incredible portrayal of grief, but also grief for somebody that you used to know that has since has moved on and lived this entire life without you. And I find even if you don't have anybody in your life that you've lost, that we've all had people that we've grown up from, and this touches on that, too. The real Kyle Mccarren is an incredible musical. The music as well is so well done. The lyrics are gorgeous, the music is gorgeous, and thankfully there is an EP that you can listen to right now. So if you do not have a chance to see it at fringe, I highly recommend at least listening to the songs. They're so incredibly well done. And this is a cast of incredible performances, including the entire band, who also jump into play roles. This is easily one of my favorite musicals of the fringe and maybe even favorite musicals of the year. It is that good. If you get a chance to go see the real Kyle Mccarren, I can't recommend it Enough! This is playing at Pleasant's courtyard through the rest of the fringe.
